Merges the two short-term epithelial pools and reprocesses them into `short-term_seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed.RDS`.

Paths are relative to this `scripts/` directory.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load Packages
```{r chunk-01}
pacman::p_load("Seurat", "dplyr", "harmony", "glue")
options(future.globals.maxSize = 4 * 1024^3)
```

# Load Data
```{r chunk-03}
# This file is post separation of epithelia/immune from 2024-02-09 data, since it was not epithelia enriched
seu_obj_short_term_epi_2024_02_09 <- readRDS("../../01-separate-epithelia-immune/outputs/short-term-2024-02-09_seu-obj-short-term-epithelia-2024-02-09-RNA-RNA_snn_res.0.5.RDS")

# This file is the direct output of htp pipeline on 2024-06-05 since it was epithelia enriched
seu_obj_short_term_epi_2024_06_05 <- readRDS("../../00-hashtag-pools/data/final-htp-seu-obj-2024-06-05-RNA.RDS")

# Remove Clusters seu_obj_short_term_epi_2024_06_05 
seu_obj_short_term_epi_2024_06_05@meta.data <- seu_obj_short_term_epi_2024_06_05@meta.data %>%
  select(-starts_with("RNA_snn_res"), -seurat_clusters)

# Combine
seu_obj_short_term_combined <- merge(seu_obj_short_term_epi_2024_02_09, seu_obj_short_term_epi_2024_06_05)

# Split based on orig.ident (seq run) for Harmony
# Join Layers (to then split)
seu_obj_short_term_combined <- JoinLayers(seu_obj_short_term_combined)

# Resplit Layers
seu_obj_short_term_combined[["RNA"]] <- split(seu_obj_short_term_combined[["RNA"]],
                                              f = seu_obj_short_term_combined$orig.ident)

# Verify that layers are as I expect
Layers(seu_obj_short_term_combined)
```

# Reprocess Pipeline
```{r chunk-04}
multi_sample_pipeline <- function(merged_seu_obj, split_col = "orig.ident", res_cols = "RNA") {
  
  if (res_cols == "SCT") {
    merged_seu_obj <- SCTransform(merged_seu_obj, verbose = FALSE)
  } else {
    merged_seu_obj <- NormalizeData(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(merged_seu_obj)
    merged_seu_obj <- ScaleData(merged_seu_obj)
  }
  
  merged_seu_obj <- RunPCA(merged_seu_obj)
  # Harmony's k-means initialisation is stochastic and carries no default seed,
  # unlike RunUMAP (seed.use = 42) and FindClusters (random.seed = 0).
  set.seed(42)
  merged_seu_obj <- RunHarmony(merged_seu_obj, assay.use = res_cols, group.by.vars = split_col)
  merged_seu_obj <- RunUMAP(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindNeighbors(merged_seu_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:40)
  merged_seu_obj <- FindClusters(merged_seu_obj, resolution = c(1:10 / 10))
  
  return(merged_seu_obj)
}
```

## Run Pipeline
```{r chunk-05}
seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed <- multi_sample_pipeline(seu_obj_short_term_combined, split_col = "orig.ident", res_cols = "RNA")

# Add ribo genes just in case
ribo_genes_mouse <- grep("^Rpl|^Rps", rownames(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed), value = TRUE)
seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, features = ribo_genes_mouse)

# View UMAP
DimPlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1")
```

## Add Previous Annotations for comparison
```{r chunk-06}
# Prior annotations, joined on barcode. Load-bearing, not just a comparison.
#
# These two columns were extracted once from
#   seu-obj-short-term-epi-V4-annotations-2024-03-24.RDS (35,981 cells)
# which lived under another user's Minerva account. The whole object was 1.1 GB and only
# these columns were ever read from it, so it is stored here as a CSV instead: the join
# below is unchanged, and this notebook now runs without cluster access.
meta_broad <- read.csv("../data/prior_annotations_epithelia_2024-03-24.csv",
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  select(barcodes, cell_type_broad, cell_type_narrow)

seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed@meta.data <- seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("barcodes") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_broad, by = "barcodes") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("barcodes")

DimPlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, group.by = "cell_type_broad", label = T)
DimPlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, group.by = "cell_type_narrow", label = T)
```

```{r chunk-07}
# Save RDS
saveRDS(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, "../outputs/short-term_seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed.RDS")
```

## 2. Feature Plots
### a. Onur Feature Plots
```{r chunk-10}
# Percent mt/ribo
pdf("../outputs/short-term_mt-ribo-FeaturePlot.pdf")
FeaturePlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, features = "percent.mt") %>% print()
FeaturePlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, features = "percent.ribo") %>% print()
dev.off()

# Onur Feature Plots
onur_markers_path <- "../data/Onur_Markers.xlsx"

onur_markers_df <- readxl::read_xlsx(onur_markers_path, sheet = "Non-Immune")
onur_markers_list <- as.list(onur_markers_df)

for (cell_type in names(onur_markers_list)) {
  
  marker_list <- na.omit(onur_markers_list[[cell_type]])
  pdf(glue("../outputs/short-term_{cell_type}-Feature-Plots.pdf"), height = 10, width = 12)
  for (gene in marker_list) {
    gene_trim <- trimws(gene)
    
    tryCatch({
      # Try to plot the feature
      Seurat::FeaturePlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, features = gene_trim) %>% print()
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Handle the error
      message(glue("Error: {e$message} for gene {gene_trim}"))
    })
  }
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

for (celltype in names(genes.of.interest)) {
  plots <- lapply(genes.of.interest[[celltype]], function(gene) {
    FeaturePlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, features = gene) + ggtitle(gene)
  })
  
  plot <- wrap_plots(plots) +  
    plot_annotation(
      title = celltype,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20))
    )
  
  # Print Plot
  print(plot)
  
  # Save Plot
  pdf(glue("../outputs/short-term_{celltype}-FeaturePlots.pdf"), height = 8, width = 12)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}
```

### 2. UCell
```{r chunk-14}
library(UCell)

seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed <- JoinLayers(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed)
seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, features = genes.of.interest, name = c('_UCell', '_UCell'))

# Save Plots
for (name in names(genes.of.interest)) {
  print(paste0(name, "_UCell"))
  
  p <- FeaturePlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, features = paste0(name, "_UCell"))
  #p <- VlnPlot(seu_obj_short_term_combined_processed, features = paste0(name, "_UCell"), group.by = "Final_Annotations")
  pdf(glue("../outputs/short-term_{name}-UCell.pdf"), height = 8, width = 12)
  p %>% print()
  dev.off()
}
```
